activation: No frontend storage adapter or new HTTP endpoint. Review database remains auth-only. Business data stays in the browser.

format.source: Original raw state JSON, integer version 1, UTF-8 (optional BOM), at most 32 MiB. Reject duplicate JSON properties and non-finite numbers.
format.environment: Required CLI argument produccion or pruebas: original backup does not contain its browser environment. Both are synthetic when staged; neither selects the active dashboard.
format.diagnosis: No SQL connection unless a registered target is explicitly supplied for additional read-only PDO preflight. Never invokes normalizeState or mutates source.
format.findings: error/review findings reject the entire attempt. optional/normalization/pending findings remain explicit. No record pruning or relationship removal to force acceptance.
format.precision: JSON decimals parsed as decimal values, not binary floats. No rounding of overprecision, negative amounts, or unsupported numeric notation. Prices normalized to exact two-decimal strings, commission to six.
format.dates: Strict calendar dates; source instants require an explicit offset and normalize to UTC microseconds. Optional nullable absence remains NULL; source field presence is preserved by the export map.
format.absence_limits: Customers missing origin or consent, and plans missing trialDays, require review because existing NOT NULL columns cannot preserve those unknown historical values. Missing statistics origin is representable as NULL.

supported: Currencies, brands, channels, accounts, projects and customers with representable required fields
Categories, formats, languages, payment methods, expense groups and categories
Plans and their available current price as unknown-date historical evidence
Products, versions, ordered links/resources, bundle membership and ordered version-channel associations
Project user statistics, same-day ordering and source timestamps
Initial SQL version snapshot; not fabricated pre-import history
identity: Existing IDs unchanged. Deterministic technical IDs for child/list rows lacking original IDs; source position and ownership are retained. SQL uniqueness checked with actual MariaDB collation before inserts.

partial_import.target: Only a NEW schema created by prepare, registered in ignored .runtime/mariadb/import-targets. local environment, 127.0.0.1, fixed local port and verified 001-004 ledger checksums required; business tables must be InnoDB.
partial_import.permissions: Dedicated per-target user with SELECT/INSERT on import tables; no business UPDATE/DELETE/DDL grants. A new temporary administrator is created using existing password-stdin procedure; no original/review credentials copied.
partial_import.backup: Private single-transaction SQL dump plus destination/SHA256 manifest verified before writes. Full source byte archive retained under ignored .runtime, including all pending data; never read as SQL export authority.
partial_import.transaction: One transaction for the entire supported dataset, environment, immutable receipt and audit. Named target lock serializes concurrent imports. No schema migration is needed in this block.
partial_import.idempotency: Stable import_ operation ID bound to the exact source bytes and deterministic plan. Same ID/payload replays committed receipt; changed payload conflicts. Different operation on occupied destination always rejects.
partial_import.recovery: Injected mid-import exception rolls back the whole dataset. Lost acknowledgement after commit is recovered by replay. Does not implement disaster restoration, dataset generations, merge, overwrite, wipe or active-dataset switching.

comparison.export: Read normalized SQL tables under environment lock and transaction. Reconstruct supported original paths using persisted path/type/presence/order metadata, not cached business values. No 500-row truncation.
comparison.verification: Compare IDs, counts and all normalized fields/relationships per table plus reconstructed supported projection and exact source SHA256. Altered SQL values must fail comparison.
comparison.normalizations: Document decimal representation, nullable empty values, UTC source instants, email casing, generated child identities and technical initial history. Absent source fields are not exported as invented source facts.
comparison.claim: Supported projection equivalence only; never whole original JSON equivalence or complete migration.

pending: Exchange rates; alerts/hourly settings; root version/setupDone/createdAt and timezone
Sales, subscriptions, expenses, treasury, infrastructure resources, suppliers, events, integrations, review, time logs and legacy log
Full domain-specific validation of unimplemented financial/integration structures; diagnostic reports their nested paths as unassessed, with generic IDs/reference/currency/date/money checks
Unrecognized priceHistory or version-history source formats require review; do not silently infer their contract
